name: A10-0300/2026 – Pierre Pimpie – § 5 – Am 7
title: REPORT on the implementation of the VAT reverse-charge mechanism
part_text: 5. Considers that the use of unanimity, including for legal definitions and clarification or administrative cooperation, safeguards the tax sovereignty of Member States without preventing them from agreeing on a harmonised approach to fighting tax fraud, evasion and avoidance;
